description: This file defines the StackWidgetProvider class, which extends AppWidgetProvider to implement a widget with a collection view, including setup for remote views, intents, and handling widget lifecycle events.

classes.name: StackWidgetProvider
classes.description: A class that extends AppWidgetProvider to manage the lifecycle and interactions of a stack widget, including handling updates, receiving intents, and managing the remote adapter.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Called when the widget is deleted; can be used for cleanup.

methods.name: onDisabled
methods.description: Called when the last instance of the widget is disabled; can be used for cleanup.

methods.name: onEnabled
methods.description: Called when the first instance of the widget is added; can be used for setup.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Receives broadcast intents for widget actions, such as handling touch events to display a toast.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Updates the widget's views, sets up the remote adapter for collection views, and configures pending intents.
